    • ENTITY_ID

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, Integer> ENTITY_ID
      The entity id that is attached to this connection.

      Note: do not expect this to be a EntityTypes.HUMAN as it maybe another entity if spectating, disguised or event not present (invisible)

    • ENTITY

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, Entity.Live<?>> ENTITY
      The entity that is attached to this connection

      Note: do not expect this to be a EntityTypes.HUMAN as it maybe another entity if spectating, disguised or event not present (invisible)

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, Boolean> IS_READY_FOR_PLAY

    • KEEP_ALIVE_TIMESTAMPS

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, Collection<Long>> KEEP_ALIVE_TIMESTAMPS
      Timestamps used for the Keep alive packet.

      Note: while this is modifiable, this data is kept up to date with Cyrus itself so likely should not be modified by drivers

    • MINECRAFT_VERSION

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, MinecraftVersion> MINECRAFT_VERSION
      The minecraft version that the client is likely using based on the protocol version

      Note: some minecraft versions use the same protocol id despite being different client versions. For this instance the lowest version will be reported

    • REQUESTED_ID

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, UUID> REQUESTED_ID
      The UUID that the client has requested it has.

      Note: This should be the same as the authenticated UUID, however if the server is in offline mode and therefore the authentication server cannot be contacted, this can be used instead. With that being said the client can lie and therefore this value should not be trusted

    • ID

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, UUID> ID
      The UUID that Cyrus reports the user as. This uses the authenticated UUID if present, if not then it will use the REQUESTED_ID as a last resort

    • REQUESTED_NAME

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, String> REQUESTED_NAME
      The username the client has requested

      Note: This should be the same as the authenticated name, however if the server is in offline mode and therefore the authentication server cannot be contacted, this can be used instead. With that being said the client can lie and therefore this value should not be trusted

    • NAME

      public static final DataKey.Native<? extends Connection<?>, String> NAME
      The username that Cyrus reports the user as. This uses the authenticated name if present, if not then it will use the REQUESTED_NAME as a last resort
